title: Stewed Saltfish with Dumplings
description: Stewed Saltfish with Dumplings is a dish from Saint Kitts and Nevis featuring salt cod, yellow onion, tomato, green bell pepper. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Soak salt cod in cold water in the refrigerator for about 24 hours, changing the water several times. Drain before simmering; never soak salted fish at room temperature.
Gently cook the prepared contents in the simmering liquid from earlier steps until fully cooked and safe to eat.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 11 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cook dumplings in batches in gently boiling salted water for about 19 minutes, until they float and the filling is cooked through. Lift out with a slotted spoon.
